Subject: dynamical systems | ID: 68227

Theorem

Every free bundle f: X -> Y between algebraic variety spaces is uniformly continuous on compact subsets.

Proof

Step 1. By the trace-class spectral theorem, we decompose \(T_{01360011} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the trace-class spectral family.

Step 2. By the Lipschitz spectral theorem, we decompose \(T_{01360012} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the Lipschitz spectral family.

Step 3. The monotone operator \(W_{01360013}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle W_{01360013} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via Fourier interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_01360011 \cdot C_01360012 \cdot C_01360013\).
